recommended_steps.detail: Power-loss hardware, protected environments, snapshots and epoch excision remain deferred. Logical deletion and unused durable content do not imply garbage collection.

what_just_landed.detail: A caller-owned immutable stage can be published with exact saved event identities, preserved remote custody and an identical durable receipt after interruption.
what_just_landed.title: Owned content publication and forward recovery

what_just_landed.detail: Real killed processes and injected write, sync and index faults preserve exact residue and require fresh recovery writes before acknowledgment. Unknown bytes are never deleted.
